messages:
maya: Quick question 3 one of my reports is relocating from EU -> US the same month we want to promote them. Manager asked if we can delay the effective date to align with US payroll/vesting. What are the rules on evidence handback and payband sync?
jordan: Payroll cutoff is usually the blocker. We try to keep the effective date within the same calendar month to avoid complex retro. If moving across regions, we sometimes set the effective date to the last day of the origin month. @samir any payroll caveats?
samir: Confirming: last-day-of-month works to minimize split-month pay, but that still creates retro in the new country if pay cycles differ. Equity/vesting is governed by comp ops, separate approval. If manager wants vesting aligned, comp + payroll need to sign off and we document retro calculation.
maya: Ok. Manager also asked what to return to the IC if evidence isn't sufficient 3 do we have a recommended handback message?
people-ops-bot: Reference: leveling checklist https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist and template /templates/leveling-evidence.md. Required: impact summary, examples, metrics, manager endorsement.
fran: Use the "evidence handback" flow in the Promo Portal: return the submission (do not delete) with coach notes, a clear list of missing items, and a deadline to resubmit. Include sample bullets like: 1) add 2 concrete examples with metrics; 2) clarify scope relative to peer group; 3) attach recent feedback <6mo.
jordan: On timelines: if you delay resubmission >30 days we auto-close and notify manager. Exceptions possible but require Sr. People Ops + Comp approval.
maya: About peer feedback 3 manager says most interactions happened 10 months ago. Is that acceptable?
samir: Standard: prefer feedback within 6 months. Up to 9 months ok with manager rationale documented. >9 months needs additional corroboration (recent project notes, metrics or manager attest). Put justification into the submission comments.
maya: Who signs off on exceptions? Manager said exec already OK'd verbally.
samir: Approval chain: Manager + Sr People Ops partner + Compensation team. Exec verbal is context but not a substitute for written approval in the Portal or Workday. Attach exec note if available; route for exception review via @people-ops.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: all approvals must be recorded in Promo Portal or Workday. For exception routing, tag @people-ops and include exec note + rationale.
fran: I'll create a short paste-in handback template for managers with bullets and a resubmission deadline to speed processing.
jordan: I'll follow up with payroll and comp ops on cutoff windows and vesting alignment. Will update this thread by EOD.
maya: Thanks folks :raised_hands:
